about.title: About & Updates
about.desc: Pulls new versions from the release manifest, verifies sha256 locally, then swaps the package and restarts. User data and configs live in the system data directory and are unaffected by updates.

about.readyDesc: The app will quit, install automatically, and reopen.
about.empty: Click “Check for Updates” to fetch the latest version.
about.note: Note: on macOS the update is applied via directory swap (same approach as Tauri), no Apple signing required; on Windows the installer runs silently.
about.downloadDone: Update package downloaded, ready to install
about.serverApplyStarted: Update triggered: Watchtower will pull the new image and recreate the container. Refresh in a few minutes.
about.serverManualHint: Server deployment: run this in the deploy directory:
about.serverNote: Note: with Watchtower configured, Docker deployments can update in one click (pulls the new image and recreates the container); otherwise run the command shown above manually.
about.credit: NAKA-AI is built on the open-source Huobao Drama project by chatfire-AI, licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (no commercial use without permission from the original author).

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to NAKA-AI
welcome.desc: Novel → script → assets → storyboard → video → final cut, all in one place. Configure AI services first, then create your first project.

create.title: Step 2 · Create a project
create.desc: Click "New Project": name it, pick an aspect ratio (landscape/portrait) and a visual style.

settings.title: Step 1 · Configure AI services
settings.desc: Every AI feature needs this first. Open Settings and add text/image/video services from the providers you use (e.g. Gemini, OpenAI).

nav.title: Everything lives here
nav.desc: Switch sections in the left sidebar: AI services, style presets, agents, general, storage, about.

topbar.title: Top bar: models & status
topbar.desc: Switch the text/image/video model for this session any time; resolution and duration tiers follow the model.

script.title: Step 1 · Script
script.desc: (Prerequisite: AI services configured in Settings.) Paste the source novel and run "AI Rewrite" to get a shooting script.

assets.title: Step 2 · Assets
assets.desc: Extract characters/scenes/props and generate consistent reference images, injected as reference material for videos.

videos.title: Step 3 · Video production
videos.desc: Break down the storyboard → review prompts → batch-generate videos; retry failures in one click. Then merge & export.

help.title: Replay anytime
help.desc: Click this "?" button to replay this page's guide. Happy creating!
